tool_args.rationale: The RK4 memory ODE fit has confirm RMSE 0.1466, well above 0.045, so it cannot be confirmed. The archive and pilot signatures leave a plausible siphon mechanism with an open-sign branch unresolved. Acquire the lower-cost open-branch discriminating probe before fitting a revised model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the source/inland-hub or hydraulic-basin siphon model, including an open branch term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fresh confirmation refuted the coupled-memory ODE. The branch sign/structure remains unresolved; the targeted open-branch probe is needed before choosing and fitting a stationary law.
The current failure is not simply a shortage of ODE rows: confirmation RMSE 0.1466 exceeds tolerance 0.045, and the open-branch probe is the lower-cost way to test a competing mechanism.
The evidence indicates mechanism mismatch, not non-stationary high-frequency oscillations; a discriminating probe can still resolve the branch.
It is explicitly nuisance and does not address the unresolved mechanism.
